title: Get fast proof of Intent CI status on the real page

intentCoverage.report:
## Intent Coverage report (verbatim)

Verdict: Assertion gap. Checked SEED-413#speed-intent-ci-status-frame-and-timing-history (plan 764) at revision 62bb2da7347e7505e92135a664e49589b7c47ce0, in a scratch worktree with its own npm ci on Node 24.21.0.

Fault: one line in dashboard/src/useIntentCiJudgment.ts — the effect cleanup no longer calls controller.abort(), so an earlier read's applyFresh and setReading(false) still run. Fixtures and assertions unchanged.

Reach: only the second half of freshness case 3. The late trunk answer lands in the separate, still-mounted project-scope IntentCiEvidenceProvider (dashboard/src/IntentPerspective.tsx), so the abort guard plays no part there. The story-scope hook instance moves from codex/example-story to codex/running-story; the trace showed applyFresh for codex/example-story (failed) arriving after the running answer was shown.

Evidence: baseline focused command passed 3/3 (case 3 at line 137 through the sidebar switches). Under the fault dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-ci-status-freshness.spec.ts still passed 3/3 while the stale answer was applied. A scratch witness adding a 300 ms wait and await ci.answers("Running at 70a0001 (Start the story)") failed with expected '' to be 'Running at 70a0001 (Start the story)'; on restored code it passed. The maintained case waits one microtask after lateFailing.resolve(...), then ci.judges(runningStory.branch) and immediate absence checks, which pass before and after the stale answer erases the status.

Restoration: hook restored, witness deleted, git status --porcelain empty, focused command 3/3 again (4.41 s), scratch worktree removed.

Next proof action: in case 3 after lateFailing.resolve(...), add a positive wait that the running story's answer is still shown; a similar check after lateTrunk.resolve guards only future regressions. Remaining gap: the first half was not tested against a fault that reaches it.

Cost: focused runs about 4.4–5.2 s each, 7 runs; human effort unavailable; agent effort about 20 tool calls; invocation-to-report elapsed 180,849 ms.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision 62bb2da73. The fault was a deliberate scratch change; the delivered production abort guard is intact, so no delivered defect. The gap fits the queued retrospective follow-up SEED-413#speed-intent-timing-history-on-vitest: plan 772 Slice 1 (correction of the delivered CI status entry) now owns the positive wait in freshness case 3, proved by the same fault failing it. No separate queue entry; the follow-up stays first.
